post.summary: Verify Truecaller profile signature and mint Firebase custom token
post.description: Verifies the Truecaller SDK RSA payload/signature against the Truecaller public key API (cached 24h in Cosmos). On success, mints a Firebase custom token for the verified phone number. Called by customer-app when truecaller_server_verify_v2 flag is ON.

200.description: Signature valid — Firebase custom token issued
